title: Labelled OPITZ examples (separate from the APSD-LATHE target)
status: 1 instructor-supplied example (brief section 1.6.3 b). Do NOT use the APSD-LATHE manual answer as an example.
how_to_add: Copy a worked example from the CAPP slides into 'examples' using the same structure. Fill source (deck + slide), validated_by and validated_on, and explain how the example geometry differs from the target.

examples.source: Course slides 'APSD.Part 02. CAPPCAM.pdf' (CO-581-B PART02, Fall 2026), slide footed 'Page 37'; example credited there to Radhakrishnan, Subramanian & Raju, CAD/CAM/CIM, 3rd ed., 2005
examples.description_of_part: Stepped rotational part with an external screw thread on its smaller end and an axial through hole (per the slide text). Dimension callouts exactly as printed on the slide drawing: 'M10 x 1.5', 'Dia.5', '1 x 45', '12.5', '20', '40', 'Dia.20', 'Dia.25', 'R2.5'.

digit_reasons.d1: Slide: 'The overall length/diameter ratio, L/D = 1.6, so the first code = 1.'
digit_reasons.d2: Slide: 'The part is stepped on both ends with a screw thread on one end, so the second digit code would be 5'
digit_reasons.d3: Slide: 'The third digit code is 1 because of the through hole.'
digit_reasons.d4: Slide: 'The fourth and fifth digits are both 0, since no surface machining is required and there are no auxiliary holes or gear teeth on the part.'
digit_reasons.d5: Slide: same sentence as d4 (no auxiliary holes or gear teeth).

examples.difference_from_target: This is a different, smaller part: it has no off-axis holes, no flat faces and a single plain through bore. It shows the METHOD only; the target must be classified solely from the TARGET MANIFEST.
examples.validated_by: Instructor-supplied worked example (Prof. Dr. Omid Fatahi Valilai, CAPP slides 'Page 37')
examples.transcribed_by: pipeline author (Claude Code), 2026-11-11, quotes copied from the slide text
